posts.text:
Here in Michigan, we’ve made a simple promise: no child should have to learn on an empty stomach.

That’s why in this year's budget, we're continuing to fund free breakfast and lunch for all 1.4 million public school students.
posts.summary: Commits to funding free meals for all public school students

posts.text: Last summer alone, nearly 9 million meals were served to Michigan kids. That’s millions of opportunities for children to stay healthy, active, and ready for what comes next.
posts.summary: Highlights child nutrition program as supporting student health and readiness

posts.text: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act puts Michigan on the fast track to lowering housing costs and building the homes hard-working families need. It’s a major step forward at a time when 9 in 10 Americans say homeownership feels out of reach.
posts.summary: Backs bipartisan housing act to lower costs and reduce regulatory barriers
posts.quote: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act puts Michigan on the fast track to lowering housing costs and building the homes hard-working families need. It’s a major step forward at a time when 9 in 10 Americans say homeownership feels out of reach.

posts.text: This new act builds on that progress by cutting red tape and supporting faster, more affordable housing development statewide.
posts.summary: Supports cutting red tape for faster, more affordable housing development
posts.quote: This new act builds on that progress by cutting red tape and supporting faster, more affordable housing development statewide.

posts.text: I want to thank Michigan’s congressional delegation, who voted unanimously to get this done, and I’m glad both Democrats and Republicans worked across the aisle to make a difference for Michiganders.
posts.summary: Praises bipartisan congressional support for housing legislation

posts.text:
There’s nothing worse than hitting a pothole on the way to work and cracking your rim or busting your axle.

Fixing the damn roads saves you and your family money: less wheel alignments, less flat tires, less money out of your pockets.
posts.summary: Argues road repairs save families money on vehicle maintenance

posts.text:
Today, I am declaring a state of emergency for Antrim, Cheboygan, and Emmet counties following severe rain and flooding that has damaged local roads and infrastructure.

This declaration will deploy critical resources and financial assistance to families and first responders.
posts.summary: Declares state of emergency for flood-damaged counties, deploys resources
posts.quote:
Today, I am declaring a state of emergency for Antrim, Cheboygan, and Emmet counties following severe rain and flooding that has damaged local roads and infrastructure.

This declaration will deploy critical resources and financial assistance to families and first responders.

posts.text:
All state resources have been made available to respond to this emergency, and the state will continue to coordinate with local governments on response and recovery efforts.

I want to thank all the first responders working tirelessly to keep Michiganders safe.
posts.summary: Mobilizes state resources for emergency response and recovery coordination

posts.text: Michigan jumped from 24th in 2019 to 6th in CNBC’s Best States for Business. This reflects years of hard work to create jobs, strengthen advanced manufacturing, support workers, and lower costs. Michigan is proving that when people choose to build and invest here, they thrive.
posts.summary: Touts Michigan's rise to 6th best state for business as policy success

We can’t fix the damn roads without the hardworking crews who get the job done.
 
Repairing our roads has supported 118,000 good-paying construction jobs, helping families thrive all across the state.
